message.content: On September 16, 2026, WolfgangSchulz proposed incorporating improvisational solos into their music practice sessions. He believed that this addition could significantly enhance their jazz fusion skills and overall enjoyment of the sessions. The idea was met with enthusiasm from the group, particularly LiHua and YurikoYamamoto, who expressed excitement about the challenge and the creative expression it would offer. The improvisational element was expected to foster a sense of community and joy among the participants, as they would no longer be bound by a set plan but rather follow the spontaneous musical flow created by each musician's contribution. The group agreed to start this new practice approach during their regular Sunday night sessions, looking forward to the experience of allowing the music to guide the jam session's direction.
